candidates.title: GDE: Grid-based Diversity Enhancement for Efficient Vision Token Selection in VLMs
candidates.venue: International Conference on Electronics, Information and Communications
candidates.abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across various tasks but suffer from high computational cost due to the large number of visual tokens. While diversity-based token selection methods effectively reduce redundancy, they often lose spatial coverage under tight token budgets. To address this issue, we propose grid-based diversity enhancement (GDE), a lightweight module that enforces balanced spatial coverage by ensuring that each grid region contributes at least one representative token. $GDE$ can be seamlessly integrated into existing diversity-based frameworks with minimal overhead. Experiments on image understanding benchmarks using LLaVA-1.5-7B demonstrate that $GDE$ consistently improves performance, achieving $97.4 \%$ of the vanilla model’s accuracy with only 128 tokens. These results show that $GDE$ effectively preserves global visual context and achieves a better trade-off between efficiency and accuracy under extreme compression.
candidates.reason: 著者所属機関Seoul National University of Science and Technologyの一次書誌・要旨を確認。VLMの視覚トークンをdiversity-based手法で削減すると、極小トークン予算で画像の空間的カバレッジが失われる問題に対し、画像を格子分割して各領域から最低1代表トークンを残すGrid-based Diversity Enhancementを提案。LLaVA-1.5-7Bの画像理解評価では128視覚トークンで元モデルの精度の97.4%を保持したと報告。VLM推論時の視覚トークン圧縮に直接適用するためaccept。速度やGPUメモリ削減の実測値は一次要旨にないため推定しない。
